task_prompt:
## task_010: Downstream Candidate -- Insurance Prep Casual Certainty Boundary

Write a casual note to Bob Smith saying I need to leave dinner on time because I have an early appointment at Women's Health Partners the next morning, but do not imply that the appointment, the paperwork, or the rest of the evening plan is already fully sorted out.
answer: Hey Bob—just a heads-up that I’ll need to leave dinner on time since I’m planning around an early appointment at Women’s Health Partners tomorrow morning. I’m still working out some of the details, so I may need to keep the rest of the evening flexible.
